---
title: "Sample Evaluated Answer Sheets (All Tests), Assignments/Quizzes (Minimum One Best, One Average and One Poor Each)"
---

```{r}
#| label: sample-evaluated-sheets
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)

chapter_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
evidence_dir <- file.path(chapter_dir, "22_sample_evaluated_sheets")

categories <- c(
  "1.best" = "Best",
  "2.average" = "Average",
  "3.poor" = "Poor"
)

exams <- c("CAE-I", "CAE-II", "PUT")

for (category in names(categories)) {

  cat(
    "\n\n### ", categories[[category]],
    " Evaluated Answer Sheets {.unnumbered}\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  for (exam in exams) {

    exam_dir <- file.path(evidence_dir, category, exam)

    if (!dir.exists(exam_dir)) next

    images <- list.files(
      exam_dir,
      pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg)$",
      full.names = TRUE,
      recursive = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )

    if (length(images) == 0L) next

    # Natural ordering: 1.png, 2.png, 10.png
    filenames <- basename(images)
    numbers <- suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(sub("^([0-9]+).*", "\\1", filenames))
    )
    images <- images[
      order(is.na(numbers), numbers, tolower(filenames))
    ]

    cat(
      "\n\n#### ", exam,
      " {.unnumbered}\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    for (image in images) {

      relative_image <- file.path(
        "22_sample_evaluated_sheets",
        category,
        exam,
        substring(
          image,
          nchar(exam_dir) + 2L
        )
      )

      relative_image <- gsub(
        "\\\\", "/", relative_image
      )

      # No image caption
      cat(
        "![](<", relative_image,
        ">){width=95%}\n\n",
        sep = ""
      )
    }
  }
}
```
